description: This file defines the VisitUnvoidHandler class which implements the logic to handle 'unvoid' operations for Visit objects in the OpenMRS system. It unvoids encounters associated with a visit when the visit itself is unvoided.

classes.name: VisitUnvoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class that unvoids encounters associated with a visit when the visit is unvoided.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Unvoids encounters associated with the specified visit that were voided with matching voided date and reason.
